criteria.notes: Venue pulse: venue identity, date, the current or next program with time, room, progress and state, plus a supporting visitor announcement.
Civic arts-centre concept retained: ruled cream frame, serif program title, accent rail marking the active state.
Reads as a foyer program board rather than a calendar list; the program panel and supporting note column are role-differentiated by design.
The program title dominates and reaches its intended size now that auto-fit resolves; the announcement column sits at a deliberately subordinate role.
Dark-theme and light-theme scenarios preserve accent rail, frame and body contrast.

The announcement title clamps at two lines, which is the strategy the generation brief declares for this element with the stated rationale that the announcement must not compete with the program. The long-content scenario is the declared evidence for that policy and the visual suite enforces it.

Program panel and announcement column divide the stage at every surface; feed-only and calendar-only scenarios promote the surviving source to the full stage, and both-empty substitutes a centred message.
Announcement media renders with a cover fit; the broken-media scenario drops the image and reflows the copy rather than leaving a gap.
The ruled cream civic frame is distinct from the dark operational and full-bleed photographic examples.
